vidore-benchmark's GitHub main branch documents a different, newer 'pipeline' subcommand (`vidore-benchmark pipeline evaluate/evaluate-all/list-datasets`) for ViDoRe v3 that this installed 5.0.0 release does not ship at all -- verified empirically via `vidore-benchmark pipeline --help` => 'No such command pipeline'. Anyone re-running this should check which CLI shape their installed version actually has.
